sb.name: Pech
sb.senses: darkvision 120 ft., tremorsense 120 ft., passive Perception 14

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The pech has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.desc: While in sunlight, the pech has disadvantage on attack rolls.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pech makes two Fortified Pickaxe attacks. If it hits a Large or smaller creature with both attacks, the target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.

actions.name: Fortified Pickaxe
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) force damage. If the target is a Construct or an object, the attack is automatically a critical hit.

actions.name: Communal Spellcasting (2/Day)
actions.desc: The pech works with three or more pechs to cast spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (save DC 12). If at least three other pechs are within 30 feet of it, the pech can cast [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Stone|Wall of Stone]]. If at least seven other pechs are within 30 feet of it, it can cast [[Tools/Spells/Greater Restoration|Greater Restoration]]. Each other pech involved in casting the spell can't have the incapacitated condition and must have at least one use of Communal Spellcasting remaining, which it must immediately expend to participate (no action required).

actions.name: Stone Shape (3/Day)
actions.desc: The pech casts [[Tools/Spells/Stone Shape|Stone Shape]], requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability.
